question.text: Blackened oil painting can be restored into original form by the action of :

solution.text:
Blackening of oil painting is due to $\mathrm{PbS}$ which is oxidised by $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}_2$ to form white $\mathrm{PbSO}_4$
$\underset{\text { (Black) }}{\mathrm{PbS}+\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}_2} \rightarrow \underset{\text { (white) }}{\mathrm{PbSO}_4}+\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}$
